name: command_batch
description: Run several engine commands in one call (fewer round trips). Returns {completed, failed, results:[{ok, result|error}]}; stops at the first error unless stop_on_error is false.

params.description: Command parameters as a JSON object (see the `params` doc in `command_list`).

wait.description:
Wait for a long command (filters, Content-Aware Fill, Photomerge, …) to finish (default
true). With false it runs as a background job and the result is `{"job": id}`: poll it
with `jobs_list`, stop it with `jobs_cancel`.

steps.description:
Commands to run in order: `[{"id": "layer.new.layer", "params": {"name": "Ink"}}, …]`. A
step with `"wait": false` starts a long command as a background job (its result is
`{"job": id}`, as in `command_run`); later steps that edit the same document fail until
the job ends.

stop_on_error.description: Stop at the first failing step (default true).

name: command_list
description: List engine commands: id, label, menu path, shortcut, parameter doc, enabled now.

enabled_only.description: Only commands that can run right now.

filter.description: Only commands whose id or label contains this text (case-insensitive).

name: command_run
description: Run an engine command by id with JSON params (see command_list). Returns the command's JSON result. Long commands (filters, Content-Aware Fill/Scale, Photomerge, brush import) wait to finish unless `wait` is false: then they run as a background job and the result is {job: id} (see jobs_list, jobs_cancel).

params.description: Command parameters as a JSON object (see the `params` doc in `command_list`).

wait.description:
Wait for a long command (filters, Content-Aware Fill, Photomerge, …) to finish (default
true). With false it runs as a background job and the result is `{"job": id}`: poll it
with `jobs_list`, stop it with `jobs_cancel`.

name: control_call
description: Bridge mode: call any control-protocol method (docs/control-protocol.md) with raw params.

name: doc_close
description: Close a document (default: the active one) without saving.

index.description: Document index from `session_list` (default: the active document).

name: doc_export
description: Export the document to another format (same as doc_save with an explicit path/format).

format.description: Format override as an extension (pcraft, psd, png, jpg, tif, webp, exr, …).

path.description:
Forward-slash relative target beneath the configured automation write root.
The extension selects the format. Omit to write back to the document's own file, which
works only for a PSD, PSB or .pcraft file kept in its own format; any other save needs
`path`, so a flattened or converted copy never replaces the opened file.

name: doc_inspect
description: Document state as JSON: layer tree (top to bottom), history, selection, active layer.

index.description: Document index from `session_list` (default: the active document).

name: doc_new
description: Create a new document (defaults: 1920x1080 RGB 8-bit white).

name: doc_open
description: Open an image or document file and make it active. Returns index, size and import warnings.

path.description: Forward-slash relative path beneath the configured automation read root.

name: doc_render_preview
description: Render the flattened document and return it as a PNG image (bridge mode: window screenshot).

max_side.description:
Longest side of a headless preview (default 1024, maximum 2048).
Zero requests full size within that ceiling. Bridge mode returns the window screenshot.

name: doc_save
description: Save the document. `.pcraft` is the lossless native format (incremental); other extensions (psd, png, jpg, tif, webp, exr, …) export. Without `path` only a PSD, PSB or .pcraft document is written back to its own         file. Returns warnings about anything the format cannot hold.

format.description: Format override as an extension (pcraft, psd, png, jpg, tif, webp, exr, …).

path.description:
Forward-slash relative target beneath the configured automation write root.
The extension selects the format. Omit to write back to the document's own file, which
works only for a PSD, PSB or .pcraft file kept in its own format; any other save needs
`path`, so a flattened or converted copy never replaces the opened file.

name: doc_select
description: Make the document at `index` active.

name: jobs_cancel
description: Cancel a background job by id (or every running job when `job` is omitted). The document is left unchanged.

job.description: The job id from `command_run` / `jobs_list` (omit to cancel every running job).

name: jobs_list
description: List background jobs: running ones with progress (0-1), message and elapsed time, then the last few that ended (state done|failed|cancelled with their result or error). Finished jobs are applied first.

name: session_list
description: List open documents (index, name, size, dirty) and the active index.

name: ui_inspect
description: Bridge mode: full UI state of the live app (tool, panels, views, dialogs, windows). For the menu tree, call `control_call` with method `ui.menu.list`.

name: ui_menu_invoke
description: Bridge mode: activate a menu item by id.

name: ui_pointer
description: Bridge mode: send pointer events (document coordinates) to the active tool.

button.description:
Mouse button: `left` (default), or `right` / `secondary`: with the Move tool or
`{"command":true}` it opens the canvas layer menu, with a painting tool the Brush Preset
picker.

name: ui_screenshot
description: Bridge mode: screenshot of the live app window as PNG.

max_side.description:
Longest side of a headless preview (default 1024, maximum 2048).
Zero requests full size within that ceiling. Bridge mode returns the window screenshot.

name: ui_set
description: Bridge mode: change UI state (tool, panels, dock, zoom, center, fit, theme, brush settings; see `fields`). Unknown fields are an error.

fields.description:
Fields for the control method `ui.set`: tool, panels, dock, dockTabs, dockWidth, maskTarget,
vectorMaskTarget, selectionMode, zoom, center, fit, theme (pro, proMedium, studio,
studioLight, classic), brushSection, brushTab, brushesView, brushSize. Other fields are an
error.
